did: On Game day, under the recorder, the phone now lists the picked game's newest three bites. Each row shows its length, whether it is on the phone or on home, Play while its sound is still on the phone, and a line saying the clock, the scenario and the unit. The list comes from the phone's own record, so it is still there after a reload, and it replaces the old single row for the bite just kept. An Undo hides the row until the phone has answered, and a failed Undo brings it back. I also wrote the logic for the big moments of a game with no bite said about them, against a list home doesn't serve yet: scores, turnovers, big plays and onside kicks count. All of it is on the branch claude/gwb14-moments, with no pull request, for the coordinator to admit. Since then: the phone now reads home's list of a game's moments exactly as the server branch serves it, and Takes keeps the id of the play home matched each bite to, which is how a moment with a bite is told apart from one without. I placed the server's new games module in the assurance ledger, which has to land here before the server's route snapshot can. I then stopped at a clean point, before drawing the dimmed moments on screen, and handed that work over in full. It is all on the branch claude/gwb14-moments at 2d0960c, with no pull request.

calls.title: The strip under the recorder shows the picked game's newest three bites, replacing the single kept-bite row (C970)
options: The newest three of the picked game, from the phone's own record
Keep the one row and add a separate strip beside it
Read the strip from home's list of takes
Show every bite of the game
calls.why: The one row was the single-bite case of this list. A bite just said isn't on home yet, and a longer list turns the recorder into Takes, which already lists a game's bites.
calls.undo: Change RECENT_BITES in the game-week package's machine file, for example to 1 for the newest bite only.

calls.title: Which moments count as big when no bite was said about them (C971)
options: Scores, turnovers, big plays and onside kicks, but not kicks
Have home mark which moments are big
calls.why: A kick moment is also every punt. The owner then ruled that field goals stay out.
calls.undo: Flip the entry in BIG_MOMENTS in the game-week package's moments file.

left: The dimmed moments with no bite aren't drawn yet: a slot in Takes for what a topic holds with no take, a runtime on the phone that fetches a game's moments, and the dimmed rows. A fresh session continues it on the same branch.
The route's contract waits on the server's route snapshot: a contract for a route the snapshot doesn't list fails this repo's drift check, so it goes in its own small PR after the snapshot lands.
If home ever sends an empty game clock, a row's line starts with the possession instead. Takes reads it the same way.
